## TC-002231 — Negative — ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction — Partial Approval Indicator

## TC-004377 — Flow — Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture — Boundary — Fuel Purchase Amount at max length (8 bytes)

**Purpose:** Fuel Purchase Amount must be numeric and must not exceed 8 bytes. (source [p.378](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=378))

## TC-004410 — Flow — Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture → Purchase/Capture — Boundary — Nonfuel Amount at max length (8 bytes)

**Purpose:** Nonfuel Amount must be numeric and must not exceed 8 bytes. (source [p.386](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=386))

## TC-004411 — Flow — Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture → Purchase/Capture — Boundary — Sequence Number at max length (6 bytes)

**Purpose:** Sequence Number must be numeric and must not exceed 6 bytes. (source [p.402](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=402))

**Derivation path:** Spec [p.402](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=402) (ATL105 2026-3) → ENT-ELEM-86 → REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:096 → derivation_method = python_template → SC-4756 (flow) → TC-004411 (transaction = Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture → Purchase/Capture)

## TC-004412 — Flow — Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture → Purchase/Capture — Boundary — Tax Amount at max length (8 bytes)

**Purpose:** Tax Amount must be numeric and must not exceed 8 bytes. (source [p.408](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=408))

**Derivation path:** Spec [p.408](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=408) (ATL105 2026-3) → ENT-ELEM-99 → REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:112 → derivation_method = python_template → SC-4757 (flow) → TC-004412 (transaction = Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture → Purchase/Capture)

## TC-004440 — Flow — Financial Transaction Request → Purchase Reversal — Boundary — Sequence Number at max length (6 bytes)

**Purpose:** Sequence Number must be numeric and must not exceed 6 bytes. (source [p.402](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=402))

**Derivation path:** Spec [p.402](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=402) (ATL105 2026-3) → ENT-ELEM-86 → REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:096 → derivation_method = python_template → SC-4785 (flow) → TC-004440 (transaction = Financial Transaction Request → Purchase Reversal)

## TC-004457 — Flow — Financial Transaction Request → Time-out Reversal — Boundary — Sequence Number at max length (6 bytes)

**Purpose:** Sequence Number must be numeric and must not exceed 6 bytes. (source [p.402](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=402))

## TC-004528 — Flow — Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture → Purchase Reversal — Boundary — Sequence Number at max length (6 bytes)

**Purpose:** Sequence Number must be numeric and must not exceed 6 bytes. (source [p.402](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=402))

## TC-004582 — Flow — Financial Transaction Request → Time-out Reversal → Financial Transaction Request — Boundary — Terminal Identifier at max length (22 bytes)

**Purpose:** Terminal Identifier must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 22 bytes. (source [p.410](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=410))

**Derivation path:** Spec [p.410](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=410) (ATL105 2026-3) → ENT-ELEM-102 → REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:115 → derivation_method = python_template → SC-4927 (flow) → TC-004582 (transaction = Financial Transaction Request → Time-out Reversal → Financial Transaction Request)

## TC-004616 — Flow — Time-out Reversal → Time-out Reversal → Time-out Reversal — Boundary — Sequence Number at max length (6 bytes)

**Purpose:** Sequence Number must be numeric and must not exceed 6 bytes. (source [p.402](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=402))

## TC-004617 — Flow — Time-out Reversal → Time-out Reversal → Time-out Reversal — Boundary — Terminal Identifier at max length (22 bytes)

**Purpose:** Terminal Identifier must be alphanumeric and must not exceed 22 bytes. (source [p.410](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=410))

**Derivation path:** Spec [p.410](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=410) (ATL105 2026-3) → ENT-ELEM-102 → REQ-SRC-ATL105-PDF-001:115 → derivation_method = python_template → SC-4962 (flow) → TC-004617 (transaction = Time-out Reversal → Time-out Reversal → Time-out Reversal)

## TC-004664 — Flow — Financial Transaction Request → Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture — Boundary — Sequence Number at max length (6 bytes)

## TC-004666 — Flow — EMV Financial Transaction Request → Purchase/Capture — Boundary — Sequence Number at max length (6 bytes)

**Purpose:** Sequence Number must be numeric and must not exceed 6 bytes. (source [p.402](../../../../../docs/specs/BUYPASS_Platform_ATL105_Message_Format_Specifications_2026-3.pdf#page=402))
